## `src\api\routes\feedback.ts`  ·  99 lines

```ts
/**
 * FEEDBACK
 * ========
 * The app stores nothing about a person — but it does need to know whether it
 * worked. This endpoint appends one line of JSON per submission to a local file
 * (no database, no accounts, no cookies), and exposes only aggregate counts.
 *
 * Deliberately no contact field: asking for an email would contradict the privacy
 * claim printed in the sidebar.
 */

import { appendFile, mkdir, readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { z } from "@workspace/api-zod";
import { logger } from "../lib/logger";

const router: IRouter = Router();

const DATA_DIR = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "data");
const DATA_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "feedback.jsonl");

const FeedbackSchema = z.object({
  rating: z.coerce.number().min(1).max(5),
  role: z.string().max(80).catch(""),
  worked: z.string().max(1200).catch(""),
  improve: z.string().max(1200).catch(""),
  lang: z.enum(["en", "bm"]).catch("en"),
});

type FeedbackRow = z.infer<typeof FeedbackSchema> & { at: string };

async function readAll(): Promise<FeedbackRow[]> {
  try {
    const raw = await readFile(DATA_FILE, "utf8");
    return raw
      .split("\n")
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((line) => {
        try {
          return JSON.parse(line) as FeedbackRow;
        } catch {
          return null;
        }
      })
      .filter((row): row is FeedbackRow => row !== null);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

const WINDOW_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_PER_WINDOW = 5;
const requestLog = new Map<string, number[]>();

function isRateLimited(key: string, now: number): boolean {
  const recent = (requestLog.get(key) ?? []).filter((at) => now - at < WINDOW_MS);
  recent.push(now);
  requestLog.set(key, recent);
  return recent.length > MAX_PER_WINDOW;
}

router.post("/feedback", async (request, response) => {
  if (isRateLimited(request.ip ?? "unknown", Date.now())) {
    response.status(429).json({ error: "rate_limited", message: "Too many submissions. Try again later." });
    return;
  }

  const parsed = FeedbackSchema.safeParse(request.body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    response.status(400).json({ error: "invalid_input", message: "A rating from 1 to 5 is required." });
    return;
  }

  const row: FeedbackRow = { ...parsed.data, at: new Date().toISOString() };

  try {
    await mkdir(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
    await appendFile(DATA_FILE, `${JSON.stringify(row)}\n`, "utf8");
    response.status(201).json({ ok: true });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error({ err: error }, "POST /feedback failed");
    response.status(503).json({ error: "unavailable", message: "Feedback could not be saved just now." });
  }
});

router.get("/feedback/summary", async (_request, response) => {
  const rows = await readAll();
  const total = rows.length;
  const average = total === 0 ? 0 : rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.rating, 0) / total;
  const distribution = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => ({
    score,
    count: rows.filter((row) => row.rating === score).length,
  }));

  response.json({ total, average: Number(average.toFixed(2)), distribution });
});

export default router;
```

## `src\api\routes\library.ts`  ·  103 lines

```ts
/**
 * WIDER ROLE LIBRARY (O*NET)
 * ==========================
 * GET /api/library?skills=Procurement,Microsoft%20Excel
 *
 * The five curated roles have real pathways and verified course links. This
 * endpoint answers the other question: "what else could I do?" It searches 916
 * real occupations from the O*NET database (U.S. Department of Labor, CC BY 4.0)
 * and ranks them by how many of the person's skills appear in the occupation's
 * description or its listed software.
 *
 * Honesty rules:
 *  - Titles and descriptions are copied verbatim from O*NET; nothing is invented.
 *  - No statistics are produced. The number shown is "how many of your skills
 *    appear in this description", not a salary, growth or hiring probability.
 *  - These occupations have no curated pathway, and the UI says so.
 */

import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import occupations from "../data/occupations.json";

const router: IRouter = Router();

type Occupation = { code: string; title: string; description: string; tools: string[] };

/** Words too common to be evidence of anything. */
const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  "and", "the", "for", "with", "from", "that", "this", "their", "other", "into",
  "such", "have", "may", "not", "are", "can", "all", "any", "use", "using",
  "work", "workers", "including", "systems", "system", "management", "support",
  "services", "knowledge", "ability", "skills", "skill", "job", "jobs",
]);

function tokenise(skills: string[]): string[] {
  const tokens = new Set<string>();
  for (const skill of skills) {
    for (const raw of skill.toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9+]+/)) {
      const token = raw.trim();
      if (token.length >= 4 && !STOP_WORDS.has(token)) tokens.add(token);
    }
  }
  return [...tokens];
}

router.get("/library", (request, response) => {
  const rawSkills = String(request.query["skills"] ?? "")
    .split(",")
    .map((value) => value.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 30);

  const tokens = tokenise(rawSkills);

  if (tokens.length === 0) {
    response.json({
      total: occupations.length,
      source: {
        name: "O*NET 30.1 Database — U.S. Department of Labor",
        url: "https://www.onetonline.org/",
        licence: "CC BY 4.0",
        retrieved: "2026-10-23",
      },
      roles: [],
      matched: 0,
    });
    return;
  }

  const scored = (occupations as Occupation[])
    .map((occupation) => {
      const haystack = `${occupation.title} ${occupation.description} ${occupation.tools.join(" ")}`.toLowerCase();
      const hits = tokens.filter((token) => haystack.includes(token));
      return { occupation, hits };
    })
    .filter((entry) => entry.hits.length > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.hits.length - a.hits.length)
    .slice(0, 24)
    .map((entry) => ({
      code: entry.occupation.code,
      title: entry.occupation.title,
      description: entry.occupation.description,
      tools: entry.occupation.tools.slice(0, 4),
      matchedSkills: entry.hits.slice(0, 4),
      matchedCount: entry.hits.length,
      // A count, not a probability: "how many of your skills this description
      // mentions". Deliberately not called a fit score.
      strength: Math.min(100, 30 + entry.hits.length * 12),
    }));

  response.json({
    total: occupations.length,
    source: {
      name: "O*NET 30.1 Database — U.S. Department of Labor",
      url: "https://www.onetonline.org/",
      licence: "CC BY 4.0",
      retrieved: "2026-10-23",
    },
    matched: scored.length,
    roles: scored,
  });
});

export default router;
```

## `src\api\routes\pathway.ts`  ·  112 lines

```ts
/**
 * PATHWAY ROUTES
 * ==============
 * POST /api/pathway
 *
 * Body: { roleTitle, skillsToBuild[], profileSummary }
 *
 * Returns an ordered study plan for ANY occupation the model proposed earlier.
 * Every step resolves to a course URL we verified in advance; the model only
 * chooses and sequences from that library. This is what lets an AI-proposed role
 * have a real pathway instead of "no pathway yet".
 */

import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { z } from "@workspace/api-zod";
import { roles } from "./workforce";
import { buildPathway, PathwayFailedError, PathwayNotConfiguredError, type VerifiedModule } from "../lib/buildPathway";
import { generalModules } from "../data/generalModules";
import { logger } from "../lib/logger";

const router: IRouter = Router();

/** Flatten the curated pathways into one de-duplicated library of verified courses. */
const library: VerifiedModule[] = [];
const seenUrls = new Set<string>();
for (const role of roles) {
  for (const module of role.learningPathway) {
    if (seenUrls.has(module.url)) continue;
    seenUrls.add(module.url);
    library.push({
      id: module.id,
      title: module.title,
      skill: module.skill,
      hours: module.hours,
      provider: module.provider,
      url: module.url,
      costNote: module.costNote,
    });
  }
}

// General courses (design, project, data) are appended so an AI-proposed
// occupation outside the curated roles still has somewhere real to go.
for (const module of generalModules) {
  if (seenUrls.has(module.url)) continue;
  seenUrls.add(module.url);
  library.push(module);
}

const RequestSchema = z.object({
  roleTitle: z.string().trim().min(2).max(120),
  skillsToBuild: z.array(z.string().max(80)).max(8).catch([]),
  profileSummary: z.string().max(600).catch(""),
  lang: z.enum(["en", "bm"]).catch("en"),
});

const WINDOW_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_REQUESTS_PER_WINDOW = 20;
const requestLog = new Map<string, number[]>();

function isRateLimited(callerKey: string, nowMs: number): boolean {
  const previous = requestLog.get(callerKey) ?? [];
  const withinWindow = previous.filter((timestamp) => nowMs - timestamp < WINDOW_MS);
  withinWindow.push(nowMs);
  requestLog.set(callerKey, withinWindow);

  if (requestLog.size > 500) {
    for (const [key, timestamps] of requestLog) {
      if (timestamps.every((timestamp) => nowMs - timestamp >= WINDOW_MS)) requestLog.delete(key);
    }
  }

  return withinWindow.length > MAX_REQUESTS_PER_WINDOW;
}

router.post("/pathway", async (request, response) => {
  if (isRateLimited(request.ip ?? "unknown", Date.now())) {
    response.status(429).json({ error: "rate_limited", message: "Too many pathway requests. Please wait a few minutes." });
    return;
  }

  const parsedBody = RequestSchema.safeParse(request.body);
  if (!parsedBody.success) {
    response.status(400).json({ error: "invalid_input", message: "A role title is required." });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const pathway = await buildPathway(
      parsedBody.data.roleTitle,
      parsedBody.data.skillsToBuild,
      parsedBody.data.profileSummary,
      library,
      parsedBody.data.lang,
    );
    response.json(pathway);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PathwayNotConfiguredError) {
      response.status(503).json({ error: "not_configured", message: "Pathway generation is not configured." });
      return;
    }
    if (error instanceof PathwayFailedError) {
      logger.error({ err: error }, "POST /pathway failed upstream");
      response.status(503).json({ error: "upstream_unavailable", message: "The planner could not be reached." });
      return;
    }
    logger.error({ err: error }, "POST /pathway failed unexpectedly");
    response.status(503).json({ error: "unexpected", message: "Something went wrong while building the pathway." });
  }
});

export default router;
```

## `src\api\routes\plan.ts`  ·  154 lines

```ts
/**
 * PLAN ROUTES
 * ===========
 * POST /api/plan
 *
 * Body: the whole profile form + the planning scenario + the app's current
 *       deterministic fit scores.
 *
 *   {
 *     "profile": { "currentRole": "...", "industry": "...", "yearsExperience": 7,
 *                  "skills": [...], "competencies": [...],
 *                  "targetSectors": [...], "weeklyHours": 6 },
 *     "mode": "Moderate" | "Aggressive",
 *     "candidates": [{ "roleId": "ai-operations", "score": 82 }, ...]
 *   }
 *
 * 200: the recommendation, the ranking with reasons and gaps, the ordered
 *      pathway, and the model's own caveat.
 * 400: malformed input.
 * 429: too many requests from this address.
 * 503: model not configured or unreachable — the UI keeps the deterministic view.
 */

import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { z } from "@workspace/api-zod";
import { roles } from "./workforce";
import { buildPlan, PlanFailedError, PlanNotConfiguredError } from "../lib/buildPlan";
import { logger } from "../lib/logger";

const router: IRouter = Router();

const PlanRequestSchema = z.object({
  profile: z.object({
    currentRole: z.string().max(200).catch(""),
    industry: z.string().max(200).catch(""),
    yearsExperience: z.coerce.number().catch(0),
    skills: z.array(z.string().max(80)).max(30).catch([]),
    competencies: z.array(z.string().max(80)).max(30).catch([]),
    targetSectors: z.array(z.string().max(80)).max(20).catch([]),
    weeklyHours: z.coerce.number().catch(6),
  }),
  mode: z.enum(["Moderate", "Aggressive"]).catch("Moderate"),
  candidates: z
    .array(z.object({ roleId: z.string(), score: z.coerce.number() }))
    .max(10)
    .optional(),
});

// Same policy as /api/extract: the model call costs the team real money and
// this URL is public. Deliberately simple; see extract.ts for the rationale.
const WINDOW_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_REQUESTS_PER_WINDOW = 20;
const requestLog = new Map<string, number[]>();

function isRateLimited(callerKey: string, nowMs: number): boolean {
  const previous = requestLog.get(callerKey) ?? [];
  const withinWindow = previous.filter((timestamp) => nowMs - timestamp < WINDOW_MS);
  withinWindow.push(nowMs);
  requestLog.set(callerKey, withinWindow);

  if (requestLog.size > 500) {
    for (const [key, timestamps] of requestLog) {
      if (timestamps.every((timestamp) => nowMs - timestamp >= WINDOW_MS)) {
        requestLog.delete(key);
      }
    }
  }

  return withinWindow.length > MAX_REQUESTS_PER_WINDOW;
}

router.post("/plan", async (request, response) => {
  const callerKey = request.ip ?? "unknown";
  if (isRateLimited(callerKey, Date.now())) {
    response.status(429).json({
      error: "rate_limited",
      message: "Too many plan requests. Please wait a few minutes.",
    });
    return;
  }

  const parsedBody = PlanRequestSchema.safeParse(request.body);
  if (!parsedBody.success) {
    response.status(400).json({
      error: "invalid_input",
      message: parsedBody.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid profile.",
    });
    return;
  }

  const { profile, mode } = parsedBody.data;

  // A prompt with no skills and no role is not a plan request, it is an empty
  // form. Reject it so the user gets a clear message instead of a generic plan.
  if (profile.skills.length === 0 && profile.competencies.length === 0 && profile.currentRole.trim() === "") {
    response.status(400).json({
      error: "empty_profile",
      message: "Add at least a current role, one skill, or one competency first.",
    });
    return;
  }

  // Fall back to neutral priors if the client did not send its scores, so the
  // model always receives the same shape of input.
  const candidates =
    parsedBody.data.candidates && parsedBody.data.candidates.length > 0
      ? parsedBody.data.candidates
      : roles.map((role) => ({ roleId: role.id, score: 50 }));

  try {
    const plan = await buildPlan(
      {
        currentRole: profile.currentRole,
        industry: profile.industry,
        yearsExperience: Math.max(0, Math.min(60, profile.yearsExperience)),
        skills: profile.skills,
        competencies: profile.competencies,
        targetSectors: profile.targetSectors,
        weeklyHours: Math.max(1, Math.min(40, profile.weeklyHours)),
      },
      mode,
      candidates,
      roles,
    );

    response.json(plan);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PlanNotConfiguredError) {
      logger.warn("POST /plan called but DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set");
      response.status(503).json({
        error: "not_configured",
        message: "AI planning is not configured on this server yet.",
      });
      return;
    }

    if (error instanceof PlanFailedError) {
      logger.error({ err: error }, "POST /plan failed upstream");
      response.status(503).json({
        error: "upstream_unavailable",
        message: "The planner could not be reached. Your deterministic results are still available.",
      });
      return;
    }

    logger.error({ err: error }, "POST /plan failed unexpectedly");
    response.status(503).json({
      error: "unexpected",
      message: "Something went wrong while building the plan.",
    });
  }
});

export default router;
```

```ts
/**
 * TREND ROUTES
 * ============
 * Exposes the trend snapshot as JSON.
 *
 *   GET /api/trends            -> cached snapshot (refresh at most every 6h)
 *   GET /api/trends?refresh=1  -> force a fresh fetch from the public source
 *
 * This is a read-only endpoint. It deliberately has no database: the source of
 * truth is the public job feed, and the snapshot carries its own source URL and
 * fetch timestamp so the UI can prove where the numbers came from.
 */

import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { roles } from "./workforce";
import { getTrends } from "../lib/trends";
import { logger } from "../lib/logger";

const router: IRouter = Router();

router.get("/trends", async (request, response) => {
  const force = request.query["refresh"] === "1";

  try {
    const snapshot = await getTrends(roles, { force });
    response.json(snapshot);
  } catch (error) {
    // 503 = "we depend on an upstream service and it is unavailable".
    // The UI shows its cached/marked-stale state instead of pretending to be live.
    logger.error({ err: error }, "GET /trends failed");
    response.status(503).json({
      error: "Trend source unavailable",
      message: "The public job feed could not be reached. Try again shortly.",
    });
  }
});

export default router;
```

```ts
export type CustomFetchOptions = RequestInit & {
  responseType?: "json" | "text" | "blob" | "auto";
};

export type ErrorType<T = unknown> = ApiError<T>;

export type BodyType<T> = T;

export type AuthTokenGetter = () => Promise<string | null> | string | null;

const NO_BODY_STATUS = new Set([204, 205, 304]);
const DEFAULT_JSON_ACCEPT = "application/json, application/problem+json";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Module-level configuration
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

let _baseUrl: string | null = null;
let _authTokenGetter: AuthTokenGetter | null = null;

/**
 * Set a base URL that is prepended to every relative request URL
 * (i.e. paths that start with `/`).
 *
 * Useful for Expo bundles that need to call a remote API server.
 * Pass `null` to clear the base URL.
 */
export function setBaseUrl(url: string | null): void {
  _baseUrl = url ? url.replace(/\/+$/, "") : null;
}

/**
 * Register a getter that supplies a bearer auth token.  Before every fetch
 * the getter is invoked; when it returns a non-null string, an
 * `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is attached to the request.
 *
 * Useful for Expo bundles making token-gated API calls.
 * Pass `null` to clear the getter.
 *
 * NOTE: This function should never be used in web applications where session
 * token cookies are automatically associated with API calls by the browser.
 */
export function setAuthTokenGetter(getter: AuthTokenGetter | null): void {
  _authTokenGetter = getter;
}

function isRequest(input: RequestInfo | URL): input is Request {
  return typeof Request !== "undefined" && input instanceof Request;
}

function resolveMethod(input: RequestInfo | URL, explicitMethod?: string): string {
  if (explicitMethod) return explicitMethod.toUpperCase();
  if (isRequest(input)) return input.method.toUpperCase();
  return "GET";
}

// Use loose check for URL — some runtimes (e.g. React Native) polyfill URL
// differently, so `instanceof URL` can fail.
function isUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): input is URL {
  return typeof URL !== "undefined" && input instanceof URL;
}

function applyBaseUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): RequestInfo | URL {
  if (!_baseUrl) return input;
  const url = resolveUrl(input);
  // Only prepend to relative paths (starting with /)
  if (!url.startsWith("/")) return input;

  const absolute = `${_baseUrl}${url}`;
  if (typeof input === "string") return absolute;
  if (isUrl(input)) return new URL(absolute);
  return new Request(absolute, input as Request);
}

function resolveUrl(input: RequestInfo | URL): string {
  if (typeof input === "string") return input;
  if (isUrl(input)) return input.toString();
  return input.url;
}

function mergeHeaders(...sources: Array<HeadersInit | undefined>): Headers {
  const headers = new Headers();

  for (const source of sources) {
    if (!source) continue;
    new Headers(source).forEach((value, key) => {
      headers.set(key, value);
    });
  }

  return headers;
}

function getMediaType(headers: Headers): string | null {
  const value = headers.get("content-type");
  return value ? value.split(";", 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase() : null;
}

function isJsonMediaType(mediaType: string | null): boolean {
  return mediaType === "application/json" || Boolean(mediaType?.endsWith("+json"));
}

function isTextMediaType(mediaType: string | null): boolean {
  return Boolean(
    mediaType &&
      (mediaType.startsWith("text/") ||
        mediaType === "application/xml" ||
        mediaType === "text/xml" ||
        mediaType.endsWith("+xml") ||
        mediaType === "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"),
  );
}

// Use strict equality: in browsers, `response.body` is `null` when the
// response genuinely has no content.  In React Native, `response.body` is
// always `undefined` because the ReadableStream API is not implemented —
// even when the response carries a full payload readable via `.text()` or
// `.json()`.  Loose equality (`== null`) matches both `null` and `undefined`,
// which causes every React Native response to be treated as empty.
function hasNoBody(response: Response, method: string): boolean {
  if (method === "HEAD") return true;
  if (NO_BODY_STATUS.has(response.status)) return true;
  if (response.headers.get("content-length") === "0") return true;
  if (response.body === null) return true;
  return false;
}

function stripBom(text: string): string {
  return text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? text.slice(1) : text;
}

function looksLikeJson(text: string): boolean {
  const trimmed = text.trimStart();
  return trimmed.startsWith("{") || trimmed.startsWith("[");
}

function getStringField(value: unknown, key: string): string | undefined {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return undefined;

  const candidate = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
  if (typeof candidate !== "string") return undefined;

  const trimmed = candidate.trim();
  return trimmed === "" ? undefined : trimmed;
}

function truncate(text: string, maxLength = 300): string {
  return text.length > maxLength ? `${text.slice(0, maxLength - 1)}…` : text;
}

function buildErrorMessage(response: Response, data: unknown): string {
  const prefix = `HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;

  if (typeof data === "string") {
    const text = data.trim();
    return text ? `${prefix}: ${truncate(text)}` : prefix;
  }

  const title = getStringField(data, "title");
  const detail = getStringField(data, "detail");
  const message =
    getStringField(data, "message") ??
    getStringField(data, "error_description") ??
    getStringField(data, "error");

  if (title && detail) return `${prefix}: ${title} — ${detail}`;
  if (detail) return `${prefix}: ${detail}`;
  if (message) return `${prefix}: ${message}`;
  if (title) return `${prefix}: ${title}`;

  return prefix;
}

export class ApiError<T = unknown> extends Error {
  readonly name = "ApiError";
  readonly status: number;
  readonly statusText: string;
  readonly data: T | null;
  readonly headers: Headers;
  readonly response: Response;
  readonly method: string;
  readonly url: string;

  constructor(
    response: Response,
    data: T | null,
    requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
  ) {
    super(buildErrorMessage(response, data));
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);

    this.status = response.status;
    this.statusText = response.statusText;
    this.data = data;
    this.headers = response.headers;
    this.response = response;
    this.method = requestInfo.method;
    this.url = response.url || requestInfo.url;
  }
}

export class ResponseParseError extends Error {
  readonly name = "ResponseParseError";
  readonly status: number;
  readonly statusText: string;
  readonly headers: Headers;
  readonly response: Response;
  readonly method: string;
  readonly url: string;
  readonly rawBody: string;
  readonly cause: unknown;

  constructor(
    response: Response,
    rawBody: string,
    cause: unknown,
    requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
  ) {
    super(
      `Failed to parse response from ${requestInfo.method} ${response.url || requestInfo.url} ` +
        `(${response.status} ${response.statusText}) as JSON`,
    );
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);

    this.status = response.status;
    this.statusText = response.statusText;
    this.headers = response.headers;
    this.response = response;
    this.method = requestInfo.method;
    this.url = response.url || requestInfo.url;
    this.rawBody = rawBody;
    this.cause = cause;
  }
}

async function parseJsonBody(
  response: Response,
  requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
): Promise<unknown> {
  const raw = await response.text();
  const normalized = stripBom(raw);

  if (normalized.trim() === "") {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(normalized);
  } catch (cause) {
    throw new ResponseParseError(response, raw, cause, requestInfo);
  }
}

async function parseErrorBody(response: Response, method: string): Promise<unknown> {
  if (hasNoBody(response, method)) {
    return null;
  }

  const mediaType = getMediaType(response.headers);

  // Fall back to text when blob() is unavailable (e.g. some React Native builds).
  if (mediaType && !isJsonMediaType(mediaType) && !isTextMediaType(mediaType)) {
    return typeof response.blob === "function" ? response.blob() : response.text();
  }

  const raw = await response.text();
  const normalized = stripBom(raw);
  const trimmed = normalized.trim();

  if (trimmed === "") {
    return null;
  }

  if (isJsonMediaType(mediaType) || looksLikeJson(normalized)) {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(normalized);
    } catch {
      return raw;
    }
  }

  return raw;
}

function inferResponseType(response: Response): "json" | "text" | "blob" {
  const mediaType = getMediaType(response.headers);

  if (isJsonMediaType(mediaType)) return "json";
  if (isTextMediaType(mediaType) || mediaType == null) return "text";
  return "blob";
}

async function parseSuccessBody(
  response: Response,
  responseType: "json" | "text" | "blob" | "auto",
  requestInfo: { method: string; url: string },
): Promise<unknown> {
  if (hasNoBody(response, requestInfo.method)) {
    return null;
  }

  const effectiveType =
    responseType === "auto" ? inferResponseType(response) : responseType;

  switch (effectiveType) {
    case "json":
      return parseJsonBody(response, requestInfo);

    case "text": {
      const text = await response.text();
      return text === "" ? null : text;
    }

    case "blob":
      if (typeof response.blob !== "function") {
        throw new TypeError(
          "Blob responses are not supported in this runtime. " +
            "Use responseType \"json\" or \"text\" instead.",
        );
      }
      return response.blob();
  }
}

export async function customFetch<T = unknown>(
  input: RequestInfo | URL,
  options: CustomFetchOptions = {},
): Promise<T> {
  input = applyBaseUrl(input);
  const { responseType = "auto", headers: headersInit, ...init } = options;

  const method = resolveMethod(input, init.method);

  if (init.body != null && (method === "GET" || method === "HEAD")) {
    throw new TypeError(`customFetch: ${method} requests cannot have a body.`);
  }

  const headers = mergeHeaders(isRequest(input) ? input.headers : undefined, headersInit);

  if (
    typeof init.body === "string" &&
    !headers.has("content-type") &&
    looksLikeJson(init.body)
  ) {
    headers.set("content-type", "application/json");
  }

  if (responseType === "json" && !headers.has("accept")) {
    headers.set("accept", DEFAULT_JSON_ACCEPT);
  }

  // Attach bearer token when an auth getter is configured and no
  // Authorization header has been explicitly provided.
  if (_authTokenGetter && !headers.has("authorization")) {
    const token = await _authTokenGetter();
    if (token) {
      headers.set("authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
    }
  }

  const requestInfo = { method, url: resolveUrl(input) };

  const response = await fetch(input, { ...init, method, headers });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorData = await parseErrorBody(response, method);
    throw new ApiError(response, errorData, requestInfo);
  }

  return (await parseSuccessBody(response, responseType, requestInfo)) as T;
}
```
