```tsx
/**
 * AI PLAN CARD
 * ============
 * The visible half of the milestone: one button sends the whole profile to
 * POST /api/plan and renders the model's conclusion.
 *
 * What the model decides: the recommended role, why, the gaps, the order of
 * the pathway, and the caveat.
 * What it cannot decide: which roles and modules exist. Those ids are checked
 * server-side against the catalogue before they reach this component.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import type { WorkforceRole } from '@workspace/api-client-react';
import { type DisruptionMode, type ProfileData, scoreRole } from '@/lib/scoring';

type PlanRankingEntry = {
  roleId: string;
  roleTitle: string;
  fit: number;
  appEstimate: number;
  reason: string;
  gaps: string[];
  sdgTargets: string[];
};

type PlanPathwayStep = {
  moduleId: string;
  title: string;
  order: number;
  hours: number;
  why: string;
};

type BuiltPlan = {
  recommendedRoleId: string;
  recommendedRoleTitle: string;
  headline: string;
  ranking: PlanRankingEntry[];
  pathway: PlanPathwayStep[];
  nextAction: string;
  caveat: string;
  model: string;
  generatedAt: string;
};

type AiPlanCardProps = {
  roles: WorkforceRole[];
  profile: ProfileData;
  mode: DisruptionMode;
};

export function AiPlanCard({ roles, profile, mode }: AiPlanCardProps) {
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<BuiltPlan | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hasSomethingToScore =
    profile.currentRole.trim() !== '' || profile.skills.length > 0 || profile.competencies.length > 0;

  async function buildPlan() {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    // The app's own scores travel with the prompt as a prior. The server clamps
    // the model's fit to within 10 points of these, so the AI cannot contradict
    // the number the user already sees without saying so in its reason.
    const candidates = roles.map((role) => ({
      roleId: role.id,
      score: scoreRole(role, profile, mode),
    }));

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/plan', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ profile, mode, candidates }),
      });

      const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as
        | (BuiltPlan & { message?: string })
        | null;

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload?.message ?? `The planner returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
      }
      if (!payload) {
        throw new Error('The planner returned an empty response.');
      }

      setPlan(payload);
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Something went wrong.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="mt-7 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-7" data-testid="card-ai-plan">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.18em] text-muted-foreground">
            <Sparkles size={12} className="text-primary" />
            AI planner
          </div>
          <h2 className="font-display mt-2 text-[23px] font-bold tracking-[-.04em]">
            Turn this profile into a plan.
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Sends your answers above to the planner, which recommends the best-fit role and orders the
            learning steps from our curated catalogue. It cannot invent roles, courses or statistics.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => { void buildPlan(); }}
          disabled={isLoading || !hasSomethingToScore}
          className="focus-ring inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 py-2.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-primary/90 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
          data-testid="button-build-plan"
        >
          <Sparkles size={14} />
          {isLoading ? 'Thinking…' : plan ? 'Rebuild plan' : 'Build my plan'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {!hasSomethingToScore ? (
        <p className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-secondary/40 p-3 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          Add a current role, a skill or a competency above, then build the plan.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-2" role="status">
          <div className="h-3 w-40 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <div className="h-3 w-full animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <div className="h-3 w-2/3 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <span className="sr-only">Building your plan</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {error ? (
        <div className="mt-5 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-accent/40 bg-accent/10 p-3" data-testid="error-ai-plan">
          <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
            {error} Your deterministic results above are unchanged.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {plan && !isLoading ? (
        <div className="mt-6 border-t border-border pt-5" data-testid="result-ai-plan">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="rounded-full bg-primary px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground">
              Recommended · {plan.recommendedRoleTitle}
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.12em] text-muted-foreground">
              {plan.model} · {new Date(plan.generatedAt).toLocaleString('en-GB')}
            </span>
          </div>

          <p className="font-display mt-3 max-w-3xl text-[18px] font-semibold leading-snug tracking-[-.02em]">
            {plan.headline}
          </p>

          <div className="mt-5 grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {plan.ranking.map((entry) => (
              <div key={entry.roleId} className="rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-secondary/30 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{entry.roleTitle}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono-ui text-[14px] font-semibold">{entry.fit}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-0.5 text-right font-mono-ui text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">
                  AI · app estimate {entry.appEstimate}
                </div>
                <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{entry.reason}</p>
                {entry.gaps.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {entry.gaps.map((gap) => (
                      <span key={gap} className="rounded border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">
                        {gap}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] text-primary">No listed gaps.</p>
                )}
                <p className="mt-2 font-mono-ui text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">
                  SDG {entry.sdgTargets.join(' · ')}
                </p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6">
            <div className="font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.15em] text-muted-foreground">
              Learning pathway
            </div>
            <ol className="mt-3 space-y-2">
              {plan.pathway.map((step) => (
                <li key={step.moduleId} className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border/70 p-3">
                  <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-secondary font-mono-ui text-[10px]">
                    {String(step.order).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-[12px] font-semibold">
                      {step.title}{' '}
                      <span className="font-normal text-muted-foreground">· {step.hours} h</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{step.why}</p>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
          </div>

          {plan.nextAction ? (
            <div className="mt-5 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/5 p-3">
              <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-primary" />
              <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
                <span className="font-semibold">Next step: </span>
                {plan.nextAction}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <p className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            <ArrowRight size={11} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            {plan.caveat || 'Directional guidance only. Always confirm course details with the provider.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * ASK AURA — floating help assistant
 * ==================================
 * Answers questions about how the app works. The backend constrains the model to
 * a fixed help text, so this panel can explain the page but can never invent a
 * job, a course or a feature.
 *
 * Plain state, no library: one message list, one input, one request.
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { MessageCircle, Send, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSettings } from '@/lib/settings';

type Message = { role: 'user' | 'assistant'; text: string };

export function AskAura() {
  const { t, lang } = useSettings();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!scrollRef.current) return;
    scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
  }, [messages, busy, open]);

  async function ask(question: string) {
    const trimmed = question.trim();
    if (trimmed.length < 2 || busy) return;

    setMessages((current) => [...current, { role: 'user', text: trimmed }]);
    setInput('');
    setBusy(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/help', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ question: trimmed, lang }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('bad response');
      const data = (await response.json()) as { answer?: string };
      setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        { role: 'assistant', text: data.answer?.trim() || t.ask.error },
      ]);
    } catch {
      setMessages((current) => [...current, { role: 'assistant', text: t.ask.error }]);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      {open ? (
        <div
          className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-[70] flex w-[min(380px,calc(100vw-2rem))] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card shadow-[0_24px_60px_-24px_rgba(20,40,36,.5)]"
          role="dialog"
          aria-label={t.ask.title}
          data-testid="ask-aura-panel"
        >
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border bg-secondary/40 px-4 py-3">
            <div>
              <p className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold tracking-[-.02em]">{t.ask.title}</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10.5px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{t.ask.subtitle}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              aria-label="Close"
              className="rounded-md p-1 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
              data-testid="button-ask-close"
            >
              <X size={15} />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div ref={scrollRef} className="max-h-[46vh] min-h-[140px] space-y-2.5 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3">
            {messages.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {t.ask.suggestions.map((suggestion) => (
                  <button
                    key={suggestion}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void ask(suggestion)}
                    className="block w-full rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-background px-3 py-2 text-left text-[11px] leading-relaxed transition-colors hover:border-primary/40 hover:bg-secondary/40"
                    data-testid="button-ask-suggestion"
                  >
                    {suggestion}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : null}

            {messages.map((message, index) => (
              <div
                key={`${message.role}-${index}`}
                className={`max-w-[92%] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed ${
                  message.role === 'user'
                    ? 'ml-auto bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
                    : 'bg-secondary/60 text-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {message.text}
              </div>
            ))}

            {busy ? (
              <div className="w-fit rounded-xl bg-secondary/60 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                {t.ask.thinking}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          <form
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              void ask(input);
            }}
            className="border-t border-border p-2.5"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                value={input}
                onChange={(event) => setInput(event.target.value)}
                placeholder={t.ask.placeholder}
                className="focus-ring min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-[11.5px] outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70"
                data-testid="input-ask-aura"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={busy || input.trim().length < 2}
                aria-label={t.ask.send}
                className="focus-ring inline-flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-40"
                data-testid="button-ask-send"
              >
                <Send size={13} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1.5 px-1 text-[9px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{t.ask.disclaimer}</p>
          </form>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-[65] inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-3 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_10px_30px_-10px_rgba(20,40,36,.6)] transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5"
        data-testid="button-ask-aura"
      >
        <MessageCircle size={14} />
        {t.ask.button}
      </button>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * AURA AVATAR
 * ===========
 * A small, drawn guide rather than a 3D asset: no model file, no dependency, no
 * weight on the bundle. It blinks, it floats on its glow, and it speaks one line
 * generated by /api/greet (cached server-side, canned fallback if the model is
 * quiet).
 *
 * Why not a real 3D head: there is no authoring pipeline here, and a 600 KB
 * WebGL scene would cost more than it returns for a hero that is read in two
 * seconds.
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useSettings } from '@/lib/settings';

type GreetResponse = { line?: string };

export function AuraAvatar() {
  const { lang } = useSettings();
  const [line, setLine] = useState<string>('');
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState('');
  const [blink, setBlink] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // One line, fetched once per language.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLine('');
    setTyped('');

    fetch(`/api/greet?lang=${lang}`)
      .then((response) => (response.ok ? (response.json() as Promise<GreetResponse>) : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setLine(data?.line?.trim() || (lang === 'bm' ? 'Jom mula dengan profil awak.' : "Let's start with your profile."));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLine(lang === 'bm' ? 'Jom mula dengan profil awak.' : "Let's start with your profile.");
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [lang]);

  // Typewriter: reveals the line character by character.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!line) return;
    setTyped('');
    let index = 0;
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      index += 1;
      setTyped(line.slice(0, index));
      if (index >= line.length) window.clearInterval(id);
    }, 24);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [line]);

  // Blink every few seconds, so the head reads as alive rather than as an icon.
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      setBlink(true);
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setBlink(false), 140);
    }, 4200);
    return () => {
      window.clearInterval(id);
      if (timer.current) window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="mt-7 flex items-center gap-4 lg:mt-9 lg:gap-6" data-testid="aura-avatar">
      <div className="relative shrink-0">
        <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 rounded-full bg-[hsl(var(--accent)/.22)] blur-xl" />
        <svg className="h-24 w-24 shrink-0 sm:h-32 sm:w-32 lg:h-44 lg:w-44" viewBox="0 0 100 100" role="img" aria-label="AURA guide">
          <defs>
            <radialGradient id="aura-head" cx="35%" cy="28%" r="78%">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="hsl(var(--primary))" stopOpacity=".95" />
              <stop offset="62%" stopColor="hsl(var(--primary))" stopOpacity=".82" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="hsl(var(--primary))" stopOpacity=".62" />
            </radialGradient>
            <linearGradient id="aura-shine" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#fff" stopOpacity=".38" />
              <stop offset="55%" stopColor="#fff" stopOpacity="0" />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>

          {/* head, slightly taller than wide, with a highlight to read as volume */}
          <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="30" ry="34" fill="url(#aura-head)" />
          <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="30" ry="34" fill="url(#aura-shine)" />
          {/* soft rim light on the right */}
          <path d="M76 34a30 34 0 0 1-6 44" stroke="hsl(var(--accent))" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity=".65" />

          {/* eyes */}
          <ellipse cx="40" cy="48" rx="3.6" ry={blink ? 0.6 : 4.4} fill="hsl(var(--primary-foreground))" />
          <ellipse cx="60" cy="48" rx="3.6" ry={blink ? 0.6 : 4.4} fill="hsl(var(--primary-foreground))" />
          {!blink ? (
            <>
              <circle cx="41.4" cy="46.6" r="1.2" fill="#fff" opacity=".9" />
              <circle cx="61.4" cy="46.6" r="1.2" fill="#fff" opacity=".9" />
            </>
          ) : null}

          {/* smile */}
          <path d="M41 62c3 4 15 4 18 0" stroke="hsl(var(--primary-foreground))" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" opacity=".85" />
        </svg>
      </div>

      <div className="relative max-w-[20rem] rounded-2xl rounded-bl-sm border border-border bg-card/95 px-4 py-3 shadow- lg:max-w-[28rem] lg:px-5 lg:py-4[0_10px_30px_-18px_rgba(20,40,36,.5)]">
        <p className="text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-foreground sm:text-[13px] lg:text-[15px]" data-testid="text-aura-line">
          {typed || '\u00A0'}
          {typed.length < line.length ? <span className="ml-0.5 inline-block w-[2px] animate-pulse bg-foreground align-middle">&nbsp;</span> : null}
        </p>
        <span className="mt-1.5 block font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[.16em] text-muted-foreground lg:text-[10px]">AURA · guide</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {
  Component,
  type ComponentType,
  type ErrorInfo,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';

export interface ErrorFallbackProps {
  error: Error;
  resetError: () => void;
}

interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  FallbackComponent?: ComponentType<ErrorFallbackProps>;
  /** Changing this clears a caught error. Pass the route to recover on navigation. */
  resetKey?: unknown;
}

interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  error: Error | null;
}

function toError(value: unknown): Error {
  if (value instanceof Error) {
    return value;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return new Error(value);
  }
  try {
    return new Error(JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch {
    return new Error(String(value));
  }
}

function DefaultFallback({ error, resetError }: ErrorFallbackProps) {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-lg w-full text-center">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">
          Something went wrong
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
          This part of the app hit an error. The rest of the app is still
          running.
        </p>
        {/* Dev only: messages can carry API responses and other internals. */}
        {import.meta.env.DEV ? (
          <pre className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto rounded bg-gray-100 p-3 text-left text-xs text-gray-800">
            {error.message || String(error)}
          </pre>
        ) : null}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={resetError}
          className="mt-4 rounded bg-gray-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white hover:bg-gray-700"
        >
          Try again
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<
  ErrorBoundaryProps,
  ErrorBoundaryState
> {
  state: ErrorBoundaryState = { error: null };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: unknown): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return { error: toError(error) };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: unknown, info: ErrorInfo): void {
    console.error(
      'ErrorBoundary caught an error:',
      toError(error),
      info.componentStack,
    );
  }

  componentDidUpdate(prevProps: ErrorBoundaryProps): void {
    if (
      this.state.error !== null &&
      prevProps.resetKey !== this.props.resetKey
    ) {
      this.resetError();
    }
  }

  resetError = (): void => {
    this.setState({ error: null });
  };

  render(): ReactNode {
    const { error } = this.state;
    if (error === null) {
      return this.props.children;
    }
    const Fallback = this.props.FallbackComponent ?? DefaultFallback;
    return <Fallback error={error} resetError={this.resetError} />;
  }
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * EXPLORE ROLES
 * =============
 * The visible half of POST /api/explore: occupations the AI proposes that are
 * NOT in the five-role curated catalogue.
 *
 * This block is deliberately styled differently from the sourced plan, because
 * it makes a weaker promise: no verified pathway, no checked course links, and
 * no statistics. What it does offer is a checkable occupational reference, so
 * the user can verify the role exists before acting on it.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, Compass, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
import type { ProfileData } from '@/lib/scoring';

type ExploredRole = {
  title: string;
  sector: string;
  reason: string;
  skillsToBuild: string[];
  firstStep: string;
  occupationSource: string;
  confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
};

type ExploreResult = {
  roles: ExploredRole[];
  note: string;
  model: string;
  generatedAt: string;
};

type ExploreRolesProps = {
  profile: ProfileData;
};

export function ExploreRoles({ profile }: ExploreRolesProps) {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ExploreResult | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const canExplore =
    profile.currentRole.trim() !== '' || profile.skills.length > 0 || profile.competencies.length > 0;

  async function explore() {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/explore', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          profile: {
            currentRole: profile.currentRole,
            industry: profile.industry,
            yearsExperience: profile.yearsExperience,
            skills: profile.skills,
            competencies: profile.competencies,
            targetSectors: profile.targetSectors,
          },
        }),
      });

      const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as
        | (ExploreResult & { message?: string })
        | null;

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.message ?? `Exploration failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
      if (!payload) throw new Error('The model returned an empty response.');

      setResult(payload);
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Something went wrong.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-7" data-testid="card-explore">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.18em] text-muted-foreground">
            <Compass size={12} className="text-primary" />
            Beyond the catalogue
          </div>
          <h2 className="font-display mt-2 text-[21px] font-bold tracking-[-.04em]">
            Not seeing your occupation?
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Our verified catalogue covers five roles. Ask the model to look wider — it will propose real
            occupations with a reference you can check, but no verified pathway and no statistics.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => { void explore(); }}
          disabled={isLoading || !canExplore}
          className="focus-ring inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-primary/40 px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary/5 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-45"
          data-testid="button-explore"
        >
          <Compass size={13} />
          {isLoading ? 'Looking…' : result ? 'Look again' : 'Explore more roles'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {error ? (
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-accent/40 bg-accent/10 p-3" data-testid="error-explore">
          <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">{error}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-2" role="status">
          <div className="h-3 w-52 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <div className="h-3 w-full animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <span className="sr-only">Exploring roles</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {result && !isLoading ? (
        <div className="mt-5 border-t border-border pt-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="rounded-full border border-accent/50 bg-accent/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">
              Exploratory · unverified demand
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.12em] text-muted-foreground">
              {result.model} · {new Date(result.generatedAt).toLocaleString('en-GB')}
            </span>
          </div>

          {result.roles.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="mt-3 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              The model did not propose an occupation it could reference. That is the correct answer here:
              it would rather say nothing than invent a job title.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
              {result.roles.map((role) => (
                <div key={role.title} className="rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-secondary/25 p-4" data-testid={`explored-${role.title}`}>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <h3 className="text-[12px] font-semibold leading-snug">{role.title}</h3>
                    <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-card px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">
                      {role.confidence}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {role.sector ? (
                    <p className="mt-0.5 font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[.1em] text-muted-foreground">
                      {role.sector}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}

                  <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{role.reason}</p>

                  {role.skillsToBuild.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="mt-3">
                      <div className="font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[.12em] text-muted-foreground">
                        Skills to build
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {role.skillsToBuild.map((skill) => (
                          <span key={skill} className="rounded border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">
                            {skill}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : null}

                  {role.firstStep ? (
                    <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed">
                      <span className="font-semibold">This week: </span>
                      {role.firstStep}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}

                  <p className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-1 border-t border-border/70 pt-2 text-[9px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                    <ExternalLink size={9} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                    Check it yourself: {role.occupationSource}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {result.note ? (
            <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{result.note}</p>
          ) : null}

          <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            These are directions to research, not a plan. No salary, growth figure or course link is shown
            here because we could not source one for these occupations.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * FEEDBACK — standalone page
 * ==========================
 * Reached from the sidebar. Five stars, two free-text questions, no account and
 * no email. The only storage is an append-only file on the server; the page shows
 * aggregate counts so a reviewer can see the app is being used.
 */

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeft, Check, Loader2, Star } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSettings } from '@/lib/settings';

const copy = {
  en: {
    back: 'Back to the planner',
    eyebrow: 'Feedback',
    title: 'Did this help you?',
    sub: 'Two minutes. No account, no email — just what worked and what did not. It is the fastest way to make the next version better.',
    ratingLabel: 'How useful was it?',
    roleLabel: 'Your role or field',
    roleOptional: 'optional',
    rolePlaceholder: 'e.g. procurement assistant',
    workedLabel: 'What worked?',
    workedPlaceholder: 'The part you would keep.',
    improveLabel: 'What should improve?',
    improvePlaceholder: 'The part that confused you, or felt missing.',
    submit: 'Send feedback',
    sending: 'Sending…',
    thanksTitle: 'Thank you.',
    thanksBody: 'Your note is saved. There is no account and no follow-up email.',
    again: 'Send another',
    error: 'Could not save that just now. Try again in a moment.',
    responses: 'responses',
    average: 'average',
    required: 'Pick a rating first.',
  },
  bm: {
    back: 'Kembali ke perancang',
    eyebrow: 'Maklum balas',
    title: 'Adakah ini membantu anda?',
    sub: 'Dua minit. Tiada akaun, tiada e-mel — hanya apa yang berkesan dan apa yang tidak. Ini cara terpantas untuk perbaiki versi seterusnya.',
    ratingLabel: 'Seberapa berguna ia?',
    roleLabel: 'Peranan atau bidang anda',
    roleOptional: 'pilihan',
    rolePlaceholder: 'cth. pembantu perolehan',
    workedLabel: 'Apa yang berkesan?',
    workedPlaceholder: 'Bahagian yang anda mahu kekalkan.',
    improveLabel: 'Apa yang perlu diperbaiki?',
    improvePlaceholder: 'Bahagian yang mengelirukan atau terasa kurang.',
    submit: 'Hantar maklum balas',
    sending: 'Menghantar…',
    thanksTitle: 'Terima kasih.',
    thanksBody: 'Nota anda telah disimpan. Tiada akaun dan tiada e-mel susulan.',
    again: 'Hantar lagi',
    error: 'Tidak dapat menyimpan sebentar tadi. Cuba lagi.',
    responses: 'respons',
    average: 'purata',
    required: 'Pilih penilaian dahulu.',
  },
} as const;

type Summary = { total: number; average: number };

export function FeedbackPage() {
  const { lang } = useSettings();
  const c = copy[lang];

  const [rating, setRating] = useState(0);
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(0);
  const [role, setRole] = useState('');
  const [worked, setWorked] = useState('');
  const [improve, setImprove] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<Summary | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/feedback/summary')
      .then((response) => (response.ok ? (response.json() as Promise<Summary>) : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (data && data.total > 0) setSummary(data);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [sent]);

  async function submit() {
    if (rating === 0) {
      setError(c.required);
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/feedback', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ rating, role, worked, improve, lang }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('bad response');
      setSent(true);
    } catch {
      setError(c.error);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (sent) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[60vh] max-w-xl flex-col justify-center py-12" data-testid="feedback-thanks">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-8 text-center">
          <span className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
            <Check size={22} />
          </span>
          <h1 className="font-display mt-4 text-[27px] font-bold tracking-[-.03em]">{c.thanksTitle}</h1>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-sm text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{c.thanksBody}</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSent(false);
              setRating(0);
              setWorked('');
              setImprove('');
            }}
            className="mt-5 rounded-lg border border-border px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold"
          >
            {c.again}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl py-10" data-testid="page-feedback">
      <a href="/" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.18em] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground">
        <ArrowLeft size={12} /> {c.back}
      </a>

      <div className="mt-6 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono-ui text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[.19em] text-muted-foreground">
        <span className="h-px w-5 bg-accent" />
        {c.eyebrow}
      </div>

      <h1 className="font-display text-[35px] font-bold leading-[1.05] tracking-[-.05em] sm:text-[43px]">{c.title}</h1>
      <p className="mt-4 max-w-xl text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{c.sub}</p>

      {summary ? (
        <p className="mt-3 font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.14em] text-muted-foreground" data-testid="feedback-summary">
          {summary.total} {c.responses} · {summary.average}/5 {c.average}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6">
        <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{c.ratingLabel}</p>
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5" data-testid="feedback-stars">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => {
            const active = score <= (hover || rating);
            return (
              <button
                key={score}
                type="button"
                onMouseEnter={() => setHover(score)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setHover(0)}
                onClick={() => {
                  setRating(score);
                  setError('');
                }}
                aria-label={`${score} of 5`}
                aria-pressed={rating === score}
                className={`focus-ring rounded-md p-1 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 ${active ? 'text-accent' : 'text-muted-foreground/40'}`}
                data-testid={`button-rating-${score}`}
              >
                <Star size={26} fill={active ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} />
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <label className="mt-6 block">
          <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{c.roleLabel} </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">({c.roleOptional})</span>
          <input
            value={role}
            onChange={(event) => setRole(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={c.rolePlaceholder}
            className="form-input mt-2"
            data-testid="input-feedback-role"
          />
        </label>

        <label className="mt-5 block">
          <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{c.workedLabel}</span>
          <textarea
            value={worked}
            onChange={(event) => setWorked(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={c.workedPlaceholder}
            rows={3}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-background p-3 text-[12px] outline-none focus:border-primary/60"
            data-testid="input-feedback-worked"
          />
        </label>

        <label className="mt-5 block">
          <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{c.improveLabel}</span>
          <textarea
            value={improve}
            onChange={(event) => setImprove(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={c.improvePlaceholder}
            rows={3}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-background p-3 text-[12px] outline-none focus:border-primary/60"
            data-testid="input-feedback-improve"
          />
        </label>

        {error ? (
          <p className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-accent/10 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-foreground" data-testid="feedback-error">
            {error}
          </p>
        ) : null}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => void submit()}
          disabled={busy}
          className="focus-ring mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-60"
          data-testid="button-feedback-submit"
        >
          {busy ? <Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin" /> : <Check size={13} />}
          {busy ? c.sending : c.submit}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * CHECKPOINT 3 — ROLES THE AI CHOSE
 * =================================
 * The list on this screen is produced by the model from the profile submitted in
 * checkpoint 2. There is no fixed set of roles displayed here: what you see is
 * what the model proposed, each with its reasoning, the skills to build, a
 * concrete first step, and an occupational reference the reader can check.
 *
 * These occupations are outside the curated pathway catalogue, so the section
 * says so plainly: no course links, no hours, no invented statistics.
 */

import { ArrowUpRight, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSettings } from '@/lib/settings';

type ExploredRole = {
  title: string;
  sector: string;
  reason: string;
  skillsToBuild: string[];
  firstStep: string;
  occupationSource: string;
  confidence: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
};

type ExploreResult = {
  roles: ExploredRole[];
  note: string;
  model: string;
  generatedAt: string;
};

type FutureRolesSectionProps = {
  explored: ExploreResult | null;
  exploredLoading: boolean;
  onBuildPathway?: (role: ExploredRole) => void;
  pathwayLoading?: boolean;
  pathwayRoleTitle?: string | null;
};

export function FutureRolesSection({ explored, exploredLoading, onBuildPathway, pathwayLoading, pathwayRoleTitle }: FutureRolesSectionProps) {
  const { t } = useSettings();
  const roles = explored?.roles ?? [];

  return (
    <section id="roles" className="scroll-mt-24 border-t border-border py-10">

        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono-ui text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[.19em] text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="h-px w-5 bg-accent" />{t.cp.threeEyebrow}
        </div>
        <h2 className="font-display max-w-3xl text-[33px] font-bold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-.055em] sm:text-[41px]">
          {t.cp.threeTitle}
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          {t.cp.threeSub}
        </p>
      </div>

      {exploredLoading ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6" role="status">
          <div className="h-3 w-48 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <div className="mt-3 h-3 w-full animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <div className="mt-3 h-3 w-2/3 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <span className="sr-only">Reading your profile</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {!exploredLoading && roles.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-border bg-card/60 p-8 text-center" data-testid="future-roles-empty">
          <Sparkles size={20} className="mx-auto text-primary" />
          <p className="font-display mt-3 text-[18px] font-bold">Nothing proposed yet</p>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-1 max-w-md text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Fill in checkpoint 2 and press <span className="font-semibold">Apply to role explorer</span> — the
            roles are generated from your answers, so there is nothing to show before that.
          </p>
          <a href="#profile" className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground">
            Go to your profile <ArrowUpRight size={12} />
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {roles.length > 0 ? (
        <>
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              {roles.length} occupations · proposed by <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{explored?.model}</span>{' '}
              · {explored ? new Date(explored.generatedAt).toLocaleString('en-GB') : ''}
            </p>
            <span className="rounded-full border border-accent/50 bg-accent/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">
              AI-selected · no verified pathway
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-3" data-testid="ai-role-cards">
            {roles.map((role) => (
              <article
                key={role.title}
                className="flex flex-col rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5"
                data-testid={`ai-role-${role.title}`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[.15em] text-muted-foreground">
                      {role.sector || 'Occupation'}
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="font-display mt-1 text-[19px] font-bold leading-tight tracking-[-.035em]">
                      {role.title}
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-secondary px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {role.confidence}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <p className="mt-3 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{role.reason}</p>

                {role.skillsToBuild.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="mt-3">
                    <div className="font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[.14em] text-muted-foreground">
                      Skills to build
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                      {role.skillsToBuild.slice(0, 5).map((skill) => (
                        <span key={skill} className="rounded border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {skill}

                      ))}
                    </div>

                ) : null}

                {role.firstStep ? (
                  <p className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-primary/5 px-2.5 py-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
                    <span className="font-semibold">This week: </span>{role.firstStep}

                ) : null}

                <p className="mt-auto border-t border-border pt-2 text-[9px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                  Check it yourself: {role.occupationSource}
                </p>
                {onBuildPathway ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onBuildPathway(role)}
                    disabled={pathwayLoading}
                    className="focus-ring mt-3 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-primary px-3 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-primary/90 disabled:opacity-50"
                    data-testid={`button-pathway-${role.title}`}
                  >
                    <Sparkles size={11} />
                    {pathwayLoading && pathwayRoleTitle === role.title ? 'Building pathway…' : 'Build verified pathway'}
                  </button>
                ) : null}
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>

          {explored?.note ? (
            <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{explored.note}</p>
          ) : null}

          <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            No salary, growth figure or course link is shown for these occupations, because we could not
            source one. The study plan in checkpoint 04 is built only from courses we have verified.
          </p>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * CHECKPOINT 4 — LEARNING PATH
 * ============================
 * Two sources, one screen:
 *
 *  1. A verified pathway built for an AI-proposed occupation (preferred). Every
 *     step links to a course URL that was fetched and checked in advance; the
 *     model only chose and ordered them.
 *  2. Fallback: the plan's pathway for the closest curated role.
 *
 * The total time is always divided by the hours the person said they actually
 * have each week, so the plan is a schedule, not a wish.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ArrowUpRight, AlertTriangle, CalendarDays, Clock3, ExternalLink, FileDown, QrCode } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSettings } from '@/lib/settings';

type PathwayStep = {
  moduleId: string;
  title: string;
  order: number;
  hours: number;
  why: string;
  provider?: string;
  url?: string;
};

type Plan = {
  recommendedRoleTitle: string;
  pathway: PathwayStep[];
  nextAction: string;
  caveat: string;
  model: string;
};

type VerifiedPathway = {
  roleTitle: string;
  steps: Array<{
    moduleId: string;
    title: string;
    skill: string;
    hours: number;
    provider: string;
    url: string;
    costNote: string;
    order: number;
    why: string;
  }>;
  topics?: Array<{ topic: string; why: string; provider: string; hours: number; searchUrl: string }>;
  totalHours: number;
  note: string;
  model: string;
  generatedAt: string;
};

type LearningPathSectionProps = {
  verified: VerifiedPathway | null;
  pathwayLoading: boolean;
  pathwayError: string | null;
  weeklyHours: number;
};

export function LearningPathSection({
  verified,
  pathwayLoading,
  pathwayError,
  weeklyHours,
}: LearningPathSectionProps) {
  const { t } = useSettings();
  const [openQr, setOpenQr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const qrFor = (url: string) => `https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=150x150&margin=0&data=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`;
  const steps: PathwayStep[] = (verified?.steps ?? []).map((step) => ({
    moduleId: step.moduleId,
    title: step.title,
    order: step.order,
    hours: step.hours,
    why: step.why,
    provider: step.provider,
    url: step.url,
  }));

  const roleTitle = verified?.roleTitle;
  const totalHours = verified?.totalHours ?? 0;
  const hoursPerWeek = Math.max(1, weeklyHours);
  const totalWeeks = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalHours / hoursPerWeek));
  const topics = verified?.topics ?? [];
  const busy = pathwayLoading;

  // One shape for the printable version, whether the plan is verified steps or topics.
  const printRows = steps.length > 0
    ? steps.map((step) => ({
        id: step.moduleId,
        title: step.title,
        hours: step.hours,
        meta: step.provider ?? '',
        why: step.why,
        url: step.url ?? '',
      }))
    : topics.map((topic, index) => ({
        id: `topic-${index}`,
        title: topic.topic,
        hours: topic.hours,
        meta: topic.provider,
        why: topic.why,
        url: topic.searchUrl,
      }));

  return (
    <section id="pathway" className="scroll-mt-24 border-t border-border py-10">
      <div className="mb-6">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono-ui text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[.19em] text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="h-px w-5 bg-accent" />{t.cp.fourEyebrow}
        </div>
        <h2 className="font-display max-w-3xl text-[33px] font-bold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-.055em] sm:text-[41px]">
          {t.cp.fourTitle}
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
          {t.cp.fourSub}
        </p>
      </div>

      {steps.length > 0 || topics.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => window.print()}
            className="focus-ring inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground"
            data-testid="button-export-pdf"
          >
            <FileDown size={13} /> {t.plan.exportPdf}
          </button>
          <span className="text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{t.plan.exportHint}</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {busy ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6" role="status">
          <div className="h-3 w-40 animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <div className="mt-3 h-3 w-full animate-pulse rounded bg-muted" />
          <span className="sr-only">Building your study plan</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {pathwayError ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-accent/40 bg-accent/10 p-4" data-testid="pathway-error">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <p className="text-[12px] leading-relaxed">
              {pathwayError} The pathway could not be generated — try again, or choose another role in checkpoint 03.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {!busy && verified && verified.steps.length === 0 && (verified.topics?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? (
        <div data-testid="topic-plan">
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">
              {t.plan.topicIntroBefore} <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{verified.roleTitle}</span> {t.plan.topicIntroAfter}
            </p>
            <span className="rounded-full border border-accent/50 bg-accent/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">
              {t.plan.topicBadge}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_260px]">
            <ol className="space-y-3">
              {(verified.topics ?? []).map((topic, index) => (
                <li key={topic.topic} className="flex items-start gap-3" data-testid={`topic-${index + 1}`}>
                  <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-background font-mono-ui text-[11px] font-medium">
                    {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                      <h3 className="font-display text-[16px] font-bold tracking-[-.02em]">{topic.topic}</h3>
                      <span className="font-mono-ui text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{topic.hours} h · {t.plan.weekLabel} {index + 1}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{topic.why}</p>
                    <a
                      href={topic.searchUrl}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary underline underline-offset-2"
                    >
                      {t.plan.searchOn} {topic.provider} <ExternalLink size={10} />
                    </a>
                    <div className="mt-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setOpenQr(openQr === `topic-${index}` ? null : `topic-${index}`)}
                        className="focus-ring inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
                        data-testid={`button-qr-topic-${index}`}
                      >
                        <QrCode size={11} /> {t.plan.showQr}
                      </button>
                      {openQr === `topic-${index}` ? (
                        <div className="mt-2 inline-flex flex-col items-start gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-2" data-testid={`qr-panel-topic-${index}`}>
                          <img src={qrFor(topic.searchUrl)} alt={`QR code for ${topic.topic}`} width={110} height={110} loading="lazy" />
                          <span className="max-w-[180px] break-all text-[9px] leading-snug text-muted-foreground">{topic.searchUrl}</span>
                        </div>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>

            <aside className="h-fit rounded-2xl bg-primary p-5 text-primary-foreground lg:sticky lg:top-24">
              <div className="font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.18em] text-primary-foreground/55">{t.plan.topicFor}</div>
              <div className="font-display mt-1 text-[19px] font-bold tracking-[-.03em]">{verified.roleTitle}</div>
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3 border-t border-primary-foreground/15 pt-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Clock3 size={14} className="text-primary-foreground/70" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-primary-foreground/50">{t.plan.estimatedTime}</div>
                    <div className="text-[15px] font-bold">{verified.totalHours} {t.plan.hours}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CalendarDays size={14} className="text-primary-foreground/70" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-primary-foreground/50">{t.plan.atWeek} {hoursPerWeek} h / {t.plan.weekLabel}</div>
                    <div className="text-[15px] font-bold">{Math.max(1, Math.ceil(verified.totalHours / hoursPerWeek))} {t.plan.weeks}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-primary-foreground/55">
                {t.plan.topicNote}
              </p>
            </aside>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {!busy && verified && verified.steps.length === 0 && (verified.topics?.length ?? 0) === 0 && !pathwayError ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-accent/40 bg-accent/10 p-6" data-testid="pathway-none">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <AlertTriangle size={16} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold">No verified course yet for {verified.roleTitle}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 max-w-xl text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                Our verified library covers AI operations, process automation, data and supply-chain skills —
                it does not yet contain a course for this occupation, and the planner is not allowed to invent
                one. Search the topic yourself, or pick another role in checkpoint 03.
              </p>
              <a
                href={`https://www.coursera.org/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(verified.roleTitle)}`}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noreferrer"
                className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary underline underline-offset-2"
              >
                Search courses for {verified.roleTitle} <ExternalLink size={10} />
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {!busy && steps.length === 0 && !pathwayError && !verified ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-border bg-card/60 p-8 text-center" data-testid="learning-path-empty">
          <CalendarDays size={20} className="mx-auto text-primary" />
          <p className="font-display mt-3 text-[18px] font-bold">{t.plan.emptyTitle}</p>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-1 max-w-md text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            {t.plan.emptyBody}
          </p>
          <a href="#roles" className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary-foreground">
            {t.plan.emptyCta} <ArrowUpRight size={12} />
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {steps.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_260px]" data-testid="learning-path">
          <ol className="space-y-3">
            {steps.map((step, index) => {
              const completedHours = steps.slice(0, index).reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.hours || 0), 0);
              const startWeek = Math.floor(completedHours / hoursPerWeek) + 1;
              const endWeek = Math.max(startWeek, Math.ceil((completedHours + Number(step.hours || 0)) / hoursPerWeek));

              return (
                <li key={step.moduleId} className="flex items-start gap-3" data-testid={`plan-step-${step.moduleId}`}>
                  <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-background font-mono-ui text-[11px] font-medium">
                    {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                      <h3 className="font-display text-[16px] font-bold tracking-[-.02em]">{step.title}</h3>
                      <span className="font-mono-ui text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                        {step.hours} h · {t.plan.weekLabel} {startWeek}{endWeek !== startWeek ? `–${endWeek}` : ''}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{step.why}</p>
                    {step.url ? (
                      <a
                        href={step.url}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noreferrer"
                        className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary underline underline-offset-2"
                        data-testid={`link-step-${step.moduleId}`}
                      >
                        {step.provider ?? 'Course'} <ExternalLink size={10} />
                      </a>
                    ) : null}
                    {step.url ? (
                      <div className="mt-2">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setOpenQr(openQr === step.moduleId ? null : step.moduleId)}
                          className="focus-ring inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
                          data-testid={`button-qr-${step.moduleId}`}
                        >
                          <QrCode size={11} /> {t.plan.showQr}
                        </button>
                        {openQr === step.moduleId ? (
                          <div className="mt-2 inline-flex flex-col items-start gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-2" data-testid={`qr-panel-${step.moduleId}`}>
                            <img src={qrFor(step.url)} alt={`QR code for ${step.title}`} width={110} height={110} loading="lazy" />
                            <span className="max-w-[180px] break-all text-[9px] leading-snug text-muted-foreground">{step.url}</span>
                          </div>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>

          <aside className="h-fit rounded-2xl bg-primary p-5 text-primary-foreground lg:sticky lg:top-24">
            <div className="font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.18em] text-primary-foreground/55">
              {t.plan.verifiedFor}
            </div>
            <div className="font-display mt-1 text-[19px] font-bold tracking-[-.03em]">{roleTitle}</div>

            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3 border-t border-primary-foreground/15 pt-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Clock3 size={14} className="text-primary-foreground/70" />
                <div>
                  <div className="font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-primary-foreground/50">{t.plan.totalTime}</div>
                  <div className="text-[15px] font-bold">{totalHours} {t.plan.hours}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <CalendarDays size={14} className="text-primary-foreground/70" />
                <div>
                  <div className="font-mono-ui text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-primary-foreground/50">{t.plan.atWeek} {hoursPerWeek} h / {t.plan.weekLabel}</div>
                  <div className="text-[15px] font-bold">{totalWeeks} {t.plan.weeks}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {verified?.note ? (
              <p className="mt-4 border-t border-primary-foreground/15 pt-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-primary-foreground/70">{verified.note}</p>
            ) : null}

            <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-primary-foreground/55">
              {t.plan.verifiedNote}
            </p>
          </aside>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Printable version: hidden on screen, the only thing the printer sees. */}
      <div id="print-plan" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-[-9999px] top-0 w-[820px]" aria-hidden>
        <div className="font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.24em]">AURA · {t.plan.printTitle}</div>
        <h1 className="mt-1 text-[27px] font-bold">{roleTitle}</h1>

        </p>
        <ol className="mt-5 space-y-3">
          {printRows.map((row, index) => (
            <li key={`print-${row.id}`} className="qr-row flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-[#ddd] pb-3">
              <span className="w-6 shrink-0 text-[12px]">{String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{row.title}</div>

                  {row.hours} h · {row.meta} · {t.plan.weekLabel} {index + 1}

                {row.url ? <div className="mt-1 break-all text-[9px]">{row.url}</div> : null}
              </div>
              {row.url ? <img src={qrFor(row.url)} alt="" width={84} height={84} /> : null}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
        <p className="mt-4 text-[10px]">{t.plan.printNote}</p>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * WIDER ROLE LIBRARY PANEL
 * ========================
 * "Show me what else I could do." Searches 916 real O*NET occupations against
 * the person's current skills and lists the closest matches.
 *
 * Deliberately different from the curated role cards: no pathway, no course
 * links, no statistics — just a real occupation, its description, and how many
 * of your skills its description mentions.
 */

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, Library } from 'lucide-react';

type LibraryRole = {
  code: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  tools: string[];
  matchedSkills: string[];
  matchedCount: number;
  strength: number;
};

type LibraryResult = {
  total: number;
  matched: number;
  source: { name: string; url: string; licence: string; retrieved: string };
  roles: LibraryRole[];
};

type LibraryExplorerProps = {
  skills: string[];
};

export function LibraryExplorer({ skills }: LibraryExplorerProps) {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<LibraryResult | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const skillKey = skills.join(',');

  async function search() {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const query = encodeURIComponent(skillKey);
      const response = await fetch(`/api/library?skills=${query}`);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`The library returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
      setResult((await response.json()) as LibraryResult);
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Something went wrong.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // Load automatically: this is the main list now, not a side panel, so the
  // user should not have to press a button to see their options.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (skillKey.trim() === '') return;
    void search();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [skillKey]);

  return (
    <section className="mt-7 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6" data-testid="card-library">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono-ui text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[.18em] text-muted-foreground">
            <Library size={12} className="text-primary" />
            Matched from 916 occupations
          </div>
          <h2 className="font-display mt-2 text-[21px] font-bold tracking-[-.04em]">
            Where your skills actually appear.
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            Real occupations from the O*NET database whose descriptions mention the skills you selected —
            including ones outside our five curated roles. They have no pathway yet, so treat them as
            directions to research.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => { void search(); }}
          disabled={isLoading || skills.length === 0}
          className="focus-ring inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-primary/40 px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary/5 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-45"
          data-testid="button-search-library"
        >
          <Library size={13} />
          {isLoading ? 'Searching…' : result ? 'Refresh matches' : 'Find matches'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {skills.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-secondary/40 p-3 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          Select a few skills in your profile first — the search matches words, so two or three specific
          skills work better than none.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {error ? (
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-accent/40 bg-accent/10 p-3" data-testid="error-library">
          <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">{error}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {result && !isLoading ? (
        <div className="mt-5 border-t border-border pt-5">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {result.matched} of {result.total} occupations mention at least one of your skills · source:{' '}
            <a
              href={result.source.url}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="font-semibold text-primary underline underline-offset-2"
            >
              {result.source.name}
            </a>{' '}
            ({result.source.licence}, retrieved {result.source.retrieved})
          </p>

          <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-2">
            {result.roles.map((role) => (
              <div
                key={role.code}
                className="rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-secondary/25 p-4"
                data-testid={`library-role-${role.code}`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                  <h3 className="text-[12px] font-semibold leading-snug">{role.title}</h3>
                  <span className="shrink-0 font-mono-ui text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {role.matchedCount} skill{role.matchedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1.5 line-clamp-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                  {role.description}
                </p>
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {role.matchedSkills.map((skill) => (
                    <span key={skill} className="rounded bg-primary/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-primary">
                      {skill}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                  {role.tools.slice(0, 2).map((tool) => (
                    <span key={tool} className="rounded border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">
                      {tool}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {result.roles.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="mt-3 text-[12px] text-muted-foreground">
              No occupation mentioned those words. Add more specific skills to your profile.
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```
